message.content: The incident has been escalated to you for a human decision because the severity score of 3.0 falls within 0.25 of a band threshold [F02][F05][F03]. Data was disclosed outside the controller via directory_listing to 203.0.113.50 [F03], affecting 2,600 records [F04]. The data was intelligible as no encryption at rest was applied [F05], and no mitigations have been recorded [F06]. Given the high severity, this triggers GDPR Art. 33(1) and Art. 34(1) obligations for notification to the authority and individuals.
